title: Two lights over the USS Holland off Spain
summary: Charlie Foltz tells of Two lights over the USS Holland off Spain, about May 1970 at USS Holland, off the coast of Spain, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: USS Holland, off the coast of Spain

tellings.quote: just as I was looking back, I saw these two lights coming toward us.

plain: A man named Charlie Foltz says that in May 1970, aboard the USS Holland, a US Navy ship off the coast of Spain, he looked back and saw two lights coming toward the ship. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast, in an episode about alien abduction, as the start of a strange encounter at sea.
